delta.note: PMK 54/2025 amends PMK 81/2024 (Coretax). It adjusts tax provisions on bullion business, gold bar imports and crypto asset trading, and deletes certain articles and attachments. Nothing in it changes PPh 21 rates, the TER tables, deductions, thresholds or calculation steps for permanent employees. It concerns other taxpayers, other taxes and administrative matters.
